verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API (mTLS/OAuth 2.0 auth, endpoints like POST /v1/cards/transactions) on a Redocly-hosted portal, but nothing in the evidence offers a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe of the standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 on all of them. Hosting docs on a Redocly portal is a host-platform trait, not evidence of a downloadable spec.
